Instructions
The fastest, easiest way to make prepayments and pay tax due is
online at tap.utah.gov. Use this payment coupon if you must pay
by check or money order.

Payment Worksheet

Do not submit this coupon if you are not making a payment.

1. Tax you expect to owe this year . . . . . . . . . . 1

Prepayments

2. Minimum payment rate  . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 2

Pay the amount on line 8 on or before the return due date.

Use this payment coupon to make individual income tax prepayments. Use the worksheet at the right to see if you are required to
make a prepayment.

3. Multiply line 1 by the rate on line 2 . . . . . . . 3

Extension Payments

5. Minimum tax due by original due date - 
enter the lesser of line 3 or line 4 . . . . . . . . . 5

You have an automatic six-month extension to file your return (no
extension form required). This is NOT an extension to pay the tax.
Use the worksheet at the right to calculate the amount you must
pay by the original due date of the return.
Penalties
If you do not pay the required amount by the original return due
date, we will assess a penalty equal to 2 percent of the unpaid tax
for each month of the extension period. We will impose a late-filing
penalty if you do file the return after the extension due date.
Interest
We will assess interest on any tax not paid by the original due
date of the return until the tax is paid in full. See Pub 58, Utah
Interest and Penalties.

● If less than zero, a payment is not due at this time.
● If greater than zero, enter amount from line 8 on the
payment coupon and send coupon with payment.
Note: By paying the amount on line 8, an extension penalty will
not be assessed, but other penalties may still apply.

More information

Mail or deliver the coupon with your payment to:

See tax.utah.gov, or call 801-297-2200 or 1-800-662-4335 .
